_how: Share image library. Each key is a 1080x1350 background in this folder (<key>.webp), served from the stats-data branch so adding one needs no Netlify deploy. Give a recap or NFL-first item "bg": "<key>" to use it behind that share card. Text sits on the bottom ~25%, so keep faces and the gag above that. originals/ holds the full-size cleaned source. No Bills, NFL or brand logos.

mia-bottle-feed.subject: Allen bottle-feeding a baby dolphin
mia-bottle-feed.notes: Nike swooshes removed from both shoulders.

share-bg-rivalry.subject: Default Allen image recolored to the white rivalry jersey (royal trim, silver numbers, gray cracked-ice shoulders and backdrop)

mia-bottle-feed-rivalry.subject: Dolphin bottle-feed image recolored to the white rivalry jersey
mia-bottle-feed-rivalry.notes: Generated from mia-bottle-feed.webp; navy bottom strip whitened.

share-bg-thanksgiving.subject: Allen gripping a roast turkey leg by the bone in his fist, "Chiefs" seared into the meat, steam rising
share-bg-thanksgiving.use: Default background on Thanksgiving (Chiefs at Bills, 2026-11-26) via theme.json bg
share-bg-thanksgiving.notes: User-supplied image (originals/ holds it as supplied, 1086x1448); scaled to 1080 wide, cropped 20px top / 70px bottom, steam added. No logos.
